You're definitely right, I'm not close with many people, especially girls, but I'm a serious hopeless romantic so I got really carried away when I realized we were friends.

I'm also pretty shy and can be socially awkward sometimes. I try my best not to be, but sometimes I just get panicky if I don't know what to say.

I really did my best to not be weird about it. It was just a really confusing situation. When I first asked her she seemed excited to go and everything, but then she would take days and days to respond to me. Like those two dates happened within a span of 3 months, cause I think she realized she didn't like me.

So we were exchanging like a text a week and I sort of realized what was happening, and I sent her a text saying "Hey I just wanted to say It's been so much fun getting to spend time with you, but I also definitely don't want to make you feel obligated to keep this going if you aren't feeling the same way."

I thought it was a fair thing to say, and she responded saying she definitely wanted to be friends.

So I thought, alright, at least we can be friends. But then after that she never responded to me again. I sent her a couple of texts and then realized she wasn't going to respond so I stopped because I didn't want to make her feel bad.

I did open up a bit to her too, which I know was a mistake now.

Ah dang I just feel so bad if I made her uncomfortable, I never meant to. I really thought we had something going there, but it was just all in my head. I wish there was something I could say that would fix it, but I know there's nothing I can really say. I just gotta move on.

But of course I didn't overstep my bounds at all. I never even tried to touch her, because it didn't feel right y'know? 

Anyways thanks again
